description: This PHP source file contains a PHPUnit test class 'EmpUsTaxExemptionAPITest' for the 'EmpUsTaxExemptionAPI' class within the OrangeHRM project. It includes multiple test methods validating load, get, update, delete operations, and validation rules for the employee US tax exemption API endpoint. It also sets up mock dependencies and fixtures specific to testing the API's functionality and behavior in the OrangeHRM HRM system.
